scope: First sourcing batch, matched against current community card slugs; no live publication
notes: Only direct asset URLs observed on listed source pages. Source match is not proof of usage rights, image quality, or visual accuracy.
No competitor stock imagery, generated location imagery, or cross-emirate replacement.
Project-specific renders must be labeled as such. Masterplan visualizations must not be presented as photographs.
Maintain canonical community identities; do not merge aliases or update live URLs in this sourcing batch.
Verify rights, download bytes, inspect pixels, hash and perceptual-hash; store approved original and derivatives in IDrive E2, then verify readback. No R2 or Supabase write.
Use text-only neutral fallback for unresolved records; no generic scenery assigned as factual geography.
